findings.title: Back to Outreach can leave a list-selected rich candidate selected
sourceRepro: Select a rich candidate from Outreach records. setSelected retains the object and returns NewsletterDestination without changing the URL.
Click Back to Outreach. It links to the identical URL. Ordinary route key and OutreachView key remain identical, leaving selected unchanged.
findings.impact: User cannot return to ordinary list using the provided same-URL navigation; no rich write/read or provider effect is established.
findings.proposedCorrection: Either route rich selections using the canonical newsletter record URL (then Back removes the rich parameter), or provide a callback that clears list selection. Preserve clientId in return navigation.
findings.requiredRegression: Select a rich candidate from the ordinary list, use Back, then successfully open/edit an ordinary record; assert no generic write for rich selection and retained client scope.

findings.title: Unavailable return link drops selected client context
sourceRepro: Visit a rich/invalid route with clientId.
Back always links to /modules/engagement?view=outreach without clientId.
findings.impact: Returns to All permitted clients rather than the selected client; no access grant or private data read is established.
findings.proposedCorrection: Use the canonical verified/hint context policy and scopedHref or a pure return-route helper; do not introduce a new client authority owner.

nonBlockingNotes: Direct-route destination copy describes saved content despite no receipt read. Prefer conditional wording; UUID hint does not establish record existence.
Duplicate conflicting view parameters use the first value; add explicit handling/characterization. Duplicate newsletter/stage IDs and mixed identity parameters already fail closed.
